literature_links.claim: Self-consistent layer polarization reduces external layer asymmetry; the minimum spectral gap differs from the layer potential.
literature_links.boundary: Single-gate continuum Hartree; our double-gate full-BZ model is related, not a matched reproduction of its numerical figures.

literature_links.claim: Infrared transitions support electric-field induced band gap, with remaining quantitative mismatch.
literature_links.boundary: Electrolyte gate, approximately 10^13 cm^-2 and 0.2-0.7eV optical range; this zero-B low-density response map does not reproduce that spectrum.

literature_links.claim: Gate fabrication and subgap conduction can substantially change low-temperature resistance.
literature_links.boundary: Source figures compare different devices and temperatures; no author raw experimental arrays obtained, no disorder/contact solver in this calculation.

scope: Full-BZ four-orbital SWMcC with homogeneous Hartree, zero magnetic field and constant tau. Fixed-U compressibility is not the self-consistent gate capacitance. Sampled gap is signed and can indicate overlap. No HF thermodynamic phase, experimental fit or original discovery.
selection_boundary: Original eight prospective points computed after freezing coefficients; four denser stress points selected after observing the first wave, with coefficients and tolerance unchanged. No independent final method evaluation.
